mapper.sql: id, parent_id, category_name, category_icon, sort, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM service_category WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
SELECT FROM service_category WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC
SELECT FROM service_category WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_category (parent_id, category_name, category_icon, sort, status) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{categoryName}, #{categoryIcon}, #{sort}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE service_category SET parent_id = #{parentId}, category_name = #{categoryName}, category_icon = #{categoryIcon}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE service_category SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
